tooltip.essentialcraft5.force_dome.en: No monsters spawn naturally within %s blocks horizontally while it runs on MRU
tooltip.essentialcraft5.force_dome.zh: 接上 MRU 后，水平 %s 格内不再自然刷出怪物

tooltip.essentialcraft5.force_dome.claim.en: Only covers chunks where its owner can build; spawners and spawn eggs still work
tooltip.essentialcraft5.force_dome.claim.zh: 只罩住放下它的人能动方块的区块；刷怪笼、刷怪蛋照常

gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.status.wo.en: Stopping natural monster spawns in %s chunk(s), %s MRU per second
gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.status.wo.zh: 正在拦 %s 块区块里的自然刷怪，每秒 %s MRU

gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.status.no.en: Nobody placed this dome by hand, so it won't work. Break it and place it again yourself
gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.status.no.zh: 这台穹顶不是玩家亲手放下的，不会工作；拆下来自己重新放一次

gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.status.ow.en: One player can run at most %s domes at the same time; the ones placed first go first
gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.status.ow.zh: 同一个人同时最多 %s 台穹顶在工作，先放下的优先

gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.status.ow.en: Break an earlier one or switch it off with redstone, and this one takes over
gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.status.ow.zh: 拆掉一台更早的、或者用红石信号关掉它，这台就接上

gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.status.po.en: Paused while it gets a redstone signal; a paused dome doesn't count towards your limit
gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.status.po.zh: 有红石信号时暂停；暂停的穹顶不占名额

gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.status.no.en: You can't build in any chunk in range (someone else's claim, spawn protection), so monsters spawn there as usual
gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.status.no.zh: 范围内的区块你都动不了方块（别人的领地、出生点附近），那里照常刷怪

gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.status.un.en: Checking whether you can build in the chunks in range (a few per second, only loaded chunks)
gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.status.un.zh: 正在确认范围内的区块你能不能动方块（每秒问几块，区块要加载着）

gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.status.un.en: The owner is offline and the earlier checks have expired; they are redone when the owner comes back
gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.status.un.zh: 主人不在线，之前确认的结果已经过期；主人上线后重新确认

gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.status.no.en: The next second needs %s MRU. Put a bound gem in the slot to feed it MRU
gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.status.no.zh: 下一秒要 %s MRU，存着的不够；在格子里放一颗绑定宝石接上 MRU

gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.status.no.en: Until it can pay for at least one chunk, it doesn't check claims either
gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.status.no.zh: 连一块区块一秒的钱都没有时，也不替你问领地

gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.status.ow.en: The owner is offline: the dome keeps using the claim checks made while they were online, until those expire
gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.status.ow.zh: 主人不在线：接着用主人在线时确认过的结果，过期的区块不再拦

gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.coverage.zh: 区块：可拦 %s · 未确认 %s · 不可拦 %s

gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.coverage..zh: 范围碰到 %s 块区块（地上 16 × 16 一块）

gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.coverage..en: OK: you can build there, so natural monster spawns are stopped
gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.coverage..zh: 可拦：你能动方块的区块，这里不再自然刷出怪物

gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.coverage..en: Unknown: not checked yet or the check expired (only loaded chunks can be checked); not stopped for now
gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.coverage..zh: 未确认：还没问过、或者结果过期了（区块要加载着才问得到），先不拦

gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.coverage..en: Denied: someone else's claim, spawn protection; monsters spawn there as usual
gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.coverage..zh: 不可拦：别人的领地、出生点附近这些你动不了方块的区块，照常刷怪

gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.coverage..en: OK chunks: each result is kept for %s min
gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.coverage..zh: 你能动的区块：结果记 %s 分钟

gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.coverage..en: Denied chunks: each result is kept for %s h and only asked again after that
gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.coverage..zh: 你动不了的区块：结果记 %s 小时，到期才再问

gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.range.zh: 半径 %s 格 · 每秒 %s MRU

gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.range.ful.en: At full load: %s MRU per second (%s per hour)
gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.range.ful.zh: 满负荷每秒 %s MRU（每小时 %s）

gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.range.par.en: When only some chunks are OK, it costs that share of the full price
gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.range.par.zh: 只有一部分区块可拦时，按比例少扣

gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.range.col.en: The radius is measured horizontally; the whole column from bedrock to sky counts
gui.essentialcraft5.force_dome.range.col.zh: 半径按水平距离算，从天到地整根柱子都算
